headline: Conference play opens with three goalless draws
dek: Midwestern State won at St. Edward's for a fifth straight win and remain the conference's only unbeaten side after nine matches. St. Mary's were the night's only other winner, beating Lubbock Christian, while UT Dallas, Dallas Baptist and Texas A&M International each drew without a goal being scored.
displaced_by: Conference play opened on 23 September: three of five matches goalless, Midwestern State won at St. Edward's

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Ten different players have scored Midwestern State's 25 goals, and Jose Ortiz has seven of them.

wire.line: Sul Ross State have lost all six of their matches without scoring a goal.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Six matches are past their date with no result published: Lubbock Christian's against Western Texas, Southwest and Hardin-Simmons, St. Edward's against Southwestern, UT Dallas's at Ouachita Baptist, and Oklahoma Christian's against Oklahoma Panhandle State.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Sul Ross State have lost all six of their matches, conceding 29 goals and scoring none.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: UT Dallas have won six, drawn two and lost one, and their nineteen goals are more than St. Edward's and West Texas A&M have scored together.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: UT Tyler have drawn four of their seven matches, more draws than any other programme in the conference.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Jake Morris has conceded seven goals for Midwestern State and kept three shutouts.

last_match.line: Midwestern State remain the conference's only unbeaten side; St. Edward's have not won since August.

next_match.line: St. Mary's have already beaten Sul Ross State once this season, and Sul Ross State have still to score a goal.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
